_comment: Example portfolio-profile.json — the identity/risk/target-allocation/contributions/constraints config that build_dashboard.py reads at runtime. portfolio-setup generates this from an interview; edit it by hand any time your situation changes. Every value below is synthetic placeholder data, not a real recommendation.

user.name: Alex Rivera
user.lifeStage: mid-30s, dual income, no near-term liquidity events planned

liquidityHorizon.note: No known near-term liquidity need — investment horizon is the standard 20+ years to retirement.

accounts.name: Joint Brokerage (Example Broker)
accounts.flexibilityNote: full taxable brokerage — any ETF or stock

accounts.name: 401(k)
accounts.flexibilityNote: limited to the plan's fund lineup — use its own fund elections, not open-market tickers

accounts.name: HSA (Example Bank)
accounts.flexibilityNote: HSA investment menu is typically limited — confirm an intl/bond fund is offered before assuming

accounts.name: Employer ESPP/RSU (Example Broker)
accounts.flexibilityNote: single-stock ESPP/RSU account — not a vehicle for diversifying into intl/bonds

accounts.name: Savings (Example Bank)
accounts.flexibilityNote: savings account — not an investing vehicle

constraints: Avoid direct exposure to companies with material operations in sanctioned countries.

Retirement readiness.source: Replace with your own retirement-plan projection once available; leave the whole entry out of this file until then.
Retirement readiness.note: This should be a forward-looking planning estimate (e.g. from a 401(k) provider's own projection tool), not this month's live portfolio total — don't confuse the two.

_valueMarks_example: OPTIONAL, goes in the real 'valueMarks' key below, empty by default. Every key must be an account name with a {markedValue, effectiveMonth, note} object — no other shape. Example: { "Private Fund Example": { "markedValue": 50000.0, "effectiveMonth": "2026-09", "note": "Dated, sourced rationale for the estimate." } }
_forecastOverrides_example: OPTIONAL, goes in the real 'forecastOverrides' key below, empty by default. Every key must be an account name with a {rateClass|skipMonths|markMultiple, note} object — no other shape. Example: { "Private Fund Example": { "rateClass": "equity", "note": "Why this account's forecast rate/contribution schedule was overridden." } }
